description: This file defines a React functional component named WorkspaceSwitcherOption, which renders a menu item with an icon and label, and toggles a popover containing a workspace-switching menu. It manages open/close state and references to DOM elements, and ties into various imported components and constants.

methods.name: WorkspaceSwitcherOption
methods.description: React functional component that renders a menu item with an icon, toggles a popover for switching workspaces, and manages open state and element references.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Callback function that toggles the open state of the popover.
